## Changes

- Added app-managed shortcut storage and a guided prompt for empty panels.
- Reorganized the management window into Panels, Wallpaper, Appearance, Import/Export, and Update tabs.
- Integrated Wallhaven browsing into the management window.
- Improved panel creation, shared appearance settings, confirmation dialogs, and scrolling.

## Download

Single EXE for Windows x64 with .NET 10 included.
